title: Eternal Son of God
definition: The eternal Son of God is the truth that Jesus Christ is the Son eternally, sharing the divine nature and glory of the Father without beginning or end.
summary: Jesus is not a temporary Son or created being; He is the eternal Son of God.
christFocus: Christ is the eternal Son who reveals the Father, shares divine glory, and brings believers into sonship through grace.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The Sonship of Christ is eternal, not something that began at Bethlehem. The Son was with the Father before the world existed and shares divine glory, nature, and authority.

This doctrine protects the Church from reducing Jesus to a created messenger or temporary representative. He is the eternal Son who came into the world, not a man who became divine.

Because the Son is eternal, His revelation of the Father is perfect, and His saving work has divine worth.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people honor Jesus while denying His eternal identity. This doctrine matters because only the eternal Son can reveal the Father fully and save sinners completely.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Worship Jesus as the eternal Son. Let His divine Sonship deepen your confidence in His words, His saving work, and His ability to bring you to the Father.
